settings.text:
The TT-THREE Pickleball Paddle is built for The Tactician, the player who wins points through patience, precision, and thoughtful shot placement. Designed for players who value control and consistency, the TT-THREE allows you to guide the rally with confidence, placing the ball exactly where it needs to go while maintaining a calm, measured approach to every point.

Engineered with a forgiving widebody shape, the TT-THREE provides exceptional stability and an enlarged sweetspot to help maintain accuracy across the paddle face. The lightweight, balanced design makes it easy to maneuver at the net while delivering smooth, controlled responses during dinks, resets, and soft touch shots.

At its core is the AccuCore Polypropylene Honeycomb Core, a proven construction designed to enhance stability and provide a predictable, controlled response. The TT-THREE features the thickest 16mm core in the range, which increases dwell time and softens impact, creating a plush, comfortable feel that absorbs vibration and improves touch on delicate shots.

The paddle also incorporates a thermoformed frame construction, reinforcing the structure of the paddle to improve durability and overall consistency. This design enhances stability across the face while maintaining the comfortable, forgiving response that control-focused players rely on when building points with precision.

Whether you’re controlling the pace at the kitchen, resetting under pressure, or placing the ball into tight spaces, the TT-THREE delivers the stability, comfort, and refined feel tactically-minded players need to outmaneuver their opponents.

settings.title: TT-THREE v1.0
settings.text: A comfortable control paddle offering a plush feel designed for intermediate to advanced players

settings.title: HYBRID FOAM CORE
settings.text:
Pure Control

  • High performance polypropylene honeycomb core built to deliver a plush, comfortable and connected feel
  • Added perimeter weighting enhances stability and consistency
  • Exceptional touch and control for dinks, drops, and resets
  • Best for: Control-first and finesse players

settings.title: THERMOFORM FRAME
settings.text:
Enhanced Stability & Durability

  • One shot thermoformed carbon fiber panel design
  • Epoxy resin coated laminates wrap the edge of the core
  • Perimeter foam adds structural strength and stiffness
  • Structure enhances power and durability

settings.title: PEEL PLY MAX
settings.text:
Enhanced Spin & Control

  • Resin-fused surface texture formed directly into the raw carbon fiber face
  • Permanent texture remains after curing for long-lasting performance
  • Grips the ball on contact to generate heavy, reliable spin
  • Consistent response lets players shape shots with confidence
  • Best for: Advanced players seeking maximum spin and precision
